plainText:
Goh's Heracross (Japanese: ゴウのヘラクロス Go's Heracros) is the twenty-eighth that Goh obtained in the Kanto region, and his fifty-seventh overall.

==History==
=== ===
====With Kricketina Kylie====
 
 was Kricketina Kylie's first known . In Trade, Borrow, and Steal!, Heracross was used to battle in the World Coronation Series, where he went up against . Despite a good fight and using powerful moves, Heracross was defeated.

Shortly after that, Kricketina took Heracross to the Pokémon Center to recover. There, he showed himself off to the people in the place. When Kricketina saw that Goh had a , she offered Heracross in exchange for it since it was a rare Pokémon in her home region.

Later, Heracross assisted Kricketina Kylie, Goh, and Ash in searching for a . During this search, Heracross helped clear the way in the forest. After it threw a tree away, Kricketina used Heracross to defeat a . The group then decided to cook and use the food to attract something close to them. To this end, Heracross and Kricketina started cooking a portion of "Kricketina Treats" to spread in the forest.

The Kricketina Treats ended up catching the attention of , who were days without food, and they decided to capture the group's Pokémon. Despite this, they only captured Ash, Goh's Sobble, and Kricketina while leaving Goh and Heracross. This forced the two to battle a and a that Jessie and James received from the Rocket Prize Master, alongside .

This battle caught the attention of Goh's Pinsir, who started to develop feelings for Heracross. Eventually, Heracross and Goh defeated Team Rocket and sent them blasting off. Afterward, Goh caught a that had been attracted to Kricketina Treats. With his first Pinsir in love with Heracross, Goh agreed to trade his newly caught Pinsir for Heracross.

====With Goh====
 
In Getting More Than You Battled For!, during a search for on Cero Island, Goh used Heracross to save from sinking in a swamp. Due to his enormous strength, he threw Ash into the air, catching him shortly after.

In Suffering the Flings and Arrows!, the arrival of a with a sweet smell made Heracross pay more attention to her than to Pinsir, which made Pinsir jealous. During an attack by on the Celadon Gym, Goh used Heracross against a , but was defeated. At the moment when the Pokémon used by Team Rocket were going to launch the final attack, Pinsir placed itself in front of Heracross and protected him, making the two Pokémon end up reconciling.

In Big Brother to the Rescue!, Heracross was still suffering the effects of Lilligant's scent, which aroused jealousy in Pinsir. To resolve this, had throw a move at Heracross's face, which temporarily fixed the problem until passed in place.

In Heroes Unite!, Heracross joined the rest of Goh's Pokémon at the lab to celebrate their Trainer's return from the last mission of Project Mew. In This Could be the Start of Something Big!, Heracross attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and Ash's departure.
 

==Personality and characteristics==
 
 
Heracross is a powerful battler. During his against Ash's Pikachu, he was able to use powerful moves against his opponent and was able to easily defeat and Jessie's Wobbuffet. When Goh's Pinsir saw Heracross in action, it fell in love with Heracross, and the two have been seen spending a lot of time with each other at the Cerise Laboratory. Their relationship evolved to the point that Heracross was a kind of "bodyguard" to Pinsir, as seen in Not Too Close for Comfort!, where Heracross rushed to throw away after it startled Pinsir. Despite their affection for each other, Heracross is easily distracted by pleasant scents, most notably from . This often results in Pinsir getting jealous and Heracross trying to apologize once he snaps out of it.

Heracross is also quite sociable, accepting Goh's commands even when he was not his yet or showing off to people who were at the Pokémon Center. Heracross is also an excellent cook, helping Kricketina Kylie prepare food meant to attract Pokémon around the forest.

During his time at the Laboratory, Heracross enjoys training with some of Goh's Pokémon, such as .
